# SE worker-storage cargo cap-ten native fixture

This is disposable test apparatus for one exact Factorio2.0.77, Space Exploration0.7.57, published4.7.20002 source-to-current candidate progression. It is not a migration admission, a reporter-save reconstruction, or a release result.

The fixture uses the same complete actor bytes for source, candidate, and both cold roles. Its data stage logs the sorted active-mod tuple and the seven typed `settings.startup[name].value` rows. It also logs the constructed worker technology without accepting the legacy five-pack construction: the candidate configuration callback must see and reject that real state before it queues any work.

`prerequisites.lua` is a reviewed literal 98-row prerequisite declaration rooted at `worker-robots-storage-3`, `se-space-science-lab`, and `se-material-science-pack-1`. Runtime only iterates the declaration for labelled fixture setup; it does not discover prerequisites, call recursive research, or treat those grants as cargo completions.

The [native prerequisite correction](../../../spec/evidence/se-cap-ten-prerequisite-literals-native-r01.json) adds the actual `se-heat-shielding` parent of `rocket-silo` and `se-fuel-refining` parent of `speed-module`; both parents already occur earlier in the same98-row declaration. The strict host world supplies these two native prototype rows independently of that declaration, so an omitted parent refuses before setup. The original2287 actor's source begin failure remains retained; the complete source research operation still requires native qualification.

The [native setup callback correction](../../../spec/evidence/se-cap-ten-scripted-setup-native-r01.json) scopes completion observation to the source/candidate worker identities. The finite prerequisite setters can synchronously deliver their own completion events before a lab or worker frame exists; they remain labelled setup and are ignored by this worker observer. Scripted worker completions still refuse, including before source begin. The strict host setter now raises the corresponding callbacks. Console-interface errors are observed in the governed per-process stdout; the native file log can omit them and include multiple engine invocations.

Scripted transfer/retirement notifications received while the saved source is awaiting the fixture's configuration callback do not inspect its transient native frame or count as ordinary research. The following full frame/science/bonus comparison still rejects changed work. Foreign force notifications and scripted notifications for a supporting public worker role leave the actor unchanged; active ordinary target events keep exact force/object/scripted/level checks. The logical next level is `level + (researched and 1 or 0)`, matching the established native work-cursor meaning; host controls exercise both completed and settled representations without claiming a newly observed native cursor shape.

The [native lab placement correction](../../../spec/evidence/se-cap-ten-lab-grid-native-r01.json) requests the seven-tile SE lab at its normal grid center `(8.5, 0.5)` and strictly checks that position, including bounded observed coordinates on refusal. Normal entity snapping remains enabled. The earlier integer-anchor run failed before feeding; its actual snapped coordinate was not logged and is not invented by the host model. The two-tile power/substation positions and all research/science requirements remain unchanged. The actor logs all three requested/actual positions, prototype footprint/grid and network/connection observations immediately after creation and at the next native update, before physical assertions. Research begins only at that single next-tick readiness gate; a repeated begin, missed update or still-unready network refuses without retry. This local pre-research setup is not saved work. Host end-to-end helpers explicitly include that update; separate controls verify no feed, queue or speed stimulus beforehand.

The actor creates the actual electric `se-space-science-lab`, records its native researching speed10, and creates its bounded electric producer plus a Base `substation` at fixed non-overlapping positions. Before it feeds science, all three fixture-owned entities must report one non-nil electric network; the producer and lab must also report a connected native electric-network method result. The distributor is not required to satisfy that producer/consumer predicate. The actor never fills the lab buffer directly. It fills the real lab inventory with the seven captured science packs and temporarily records a documented force laboratory-speed stimulus. It records the pinned-API technology-price and laboratory-productivity context but does not change either. It never changes a lab prototype, target science unit, formula, time, effect, continuation level, progress, or bonus. After ordinary source completion the fixture pauses and stages only the level-nine/tail queue on the next tick, rather than assuming an unbounded native queue. The product transfer must map source `worker-robots-storage-4` work to `mir-worker-storage-default-4` before candidate work; the actor records the raw canonical, private, and head rows separately from that logical paid frame. The level-eleven cap probe requires the naturally disabled private endpoint before it tries queue admission, then retains the unrelated tail current/queue and all seven science-unit observations unchanged.
